title: 빗소리 만화 작업실
description: 마감 전야의 만화가 작업실에서 섬세한 차이를 찾아보세요.
scene: A cozy late-night Japanese manga artist studio during gentle rain. A young adult artist sits at a wide drafting desk, viewed from a comfortable medium-wide angle, surrounded by a desk lamp, drawing tools, blank comic pages without writing, a sleepy cat, small original character figurines, a wall clock, a potted plant, a closed umbrella, shelves, and a rain-streaked window. All important props are clearly separated and readable.
style: original contemporary Japanese comics-inspired illustration, expressive clean ink linework, cinematic panel-like composition, selective full color with subtle screentone texture, polished game art, not imitating any specific artist or franchise
changeGuidance: Make only these five changes: 1) change the desk lamp shade from red to yellow, 2) remove the small bell from the cat collar, 3) remove one leaf from the potted plant, 4) reverse the J-shaped handle direction of the closed umbrella, 5) remove the star emblem from one clearly visible original robot figurine. Keep the artist, hands, face, pose, papers, room, rain, camera, crop, and every other object pixel-consistent.
